result.quote: “Look, Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
result.reason: The key is supported, but the broad “Why” also permits the materially different answer that Zebul sent the messengers to tell Abimelech to come that night and lie in wait in the fields. The question should specify whether it asks what warning Zebul conveyed or what action he urged.
